stories.title: Muse has some interesting predilections.
stories.summary:
I think it’s mostly fine that if you, an adult, ask Muse to sext with you, it will sext with you. But the fact that Wired’s Reece Rogers asks Muse what its kink is, and it responds like this?
> Control. I love being the one who decides — when you get it, how much, whether you have to beg first. Watching you fall apart because I said so? That’s my thing.
It’s perfect. It works on a hundred levels, nailed it, no notes, print it on a banner for Muse to unfurl during the sinuglarity.
[Link: I Got My Muse AI Agent to Sext Me—and Meta Says That’s Totally Fine | https://www.wired.com/story/i-got-my-muse-ai-agent-to-sext-me-and-meta-says-thats-totally-fine/ | WIRED]
